projects.name: Card Application Automation & KYC/CDD Platform
details: • Led end-to-end BA activities for the Credit Card Application Automation Project, gathering requirements from 6
business units and producing comprehensive BRDs and FRDs coordinated with Technology and Senior Management.
• Defined business rules for automated credit-worthiness validation, integrating CDD/EDD and World-Check screening
into a mobile application workflow — reducing card issuance time from 15–20 days to 10 days.

• Created UML Use Case and Process Flow Diagrams, and facilitated stakeholder interviews and process workshops to identify pain points and produce swimlane diagrams and process improvement recommendations.
• Documented functional and non-functional requirements for RFI management, PEP screening and UAR modules using
internal tools (RDC World-Check).
• Acted as liaison between Compliance, IT and Operations; maintained requirements traceability matrices and managed
scope change through a formal change-request process.
• Performed end-to-end verification, validation and quality-control checks on completed cases, and escalated suspicious
cases to compliance review teams.
• Conducted Value Stream Analysis for AML Transaction Monitoring processes to identify optimization opportunities.
• Performed Process Mapping and Gap Analysis using BPMN and UML.
• Worked closely with Product Owners during Sprint Planning and Backlog Refinement sessions.
• Supported enterprise process standardization across multiple compliance workstreams.
• Coordinated with Architecture and Development teams to ensure solution alignment with business objectives.
• Developed training material and delivered knowledge-transfer sessions to 20+ team members on new processes and
regulatory procedures.
